==> Check this machine
  check  kvm: /dev/kvm opens read-write
  check  nested virtualisation: no kvm_intel or kvm_amd module loaded
==> Install kantel-host dev
  mkdir  $TMP/usr
  mkdir  $TMP/usr/local
  mkdir  $TMP/usr/local/bin
  copy   $TMP/download/kantel-host to $TMP/usr/local/bin/kantel-host (mode 0755)
==> Fetch Firecracker and the sandbox images
  check  images host-images-test from $TMP/images/manifest.json
  mkdir  $TMP/var
  mkdir  $TMP/var/lib
  mkdir  $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host
  mkdir  $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/bin
  get    https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/releases/download/v1.17.0/firecracker-v1.17.0-$FCARCH.tgz (sha256 $FCSHA, from firecracker-v1.17.0-$FCARCH.tgz.sha256.txt), its firecracker-v1.17.0-$FCARCH to $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/bin/firecracker (mode 0755)
  mkdir  $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/images
  get    $TMP/images/vmlinux-$ARCH to $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/images/vmlinux (sha256 b7bcc09097dbd51a5d5ec37d619fb92044f38afb1831c12efa3dcbbd9148319c, mode 0644)
  get    $TMP/images/sandbox-$ARCH.ext4 to $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/images/sandbox.ext4 (sha256 dd18202e5bf40faffcd3b72ce1bde2fa6a1b35820ec3c5cdabe880e75340c1f4, mode 0644)
  get    $TMP/images/isolate-$ARCH.ext4 to $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/images/isolate.ext4 (sha256 9fb226da0d1b903a8bc7f9e23b3ab8f37300cb20acf2371143ecefc3459a4efc, mode 0644)
  get    $TMP/images/kantel-guest-$ARCH to $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host/images/kantel-guest (sha256 575a6c27ce3f48c81242ae0a9ec0dd8ffdd4afd6991511a625f5a4452beea316, mode 0755)
==> Register with https://kantel.example.com
  mkdir  $TMP/etc
  mkdir  $TMP/etc/kantel-host
  post   https://kantel.example.com/v1/hosts/register as "builder-1" with labels gpu=none, zone=ams, which uses the token up
  note   to report what this host can run, registering starts its tiers for a moment, which makes their directories under $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host and, for microVMs, sets up the network rules below
==> Save the settings
  write  $TMP/etc/kantel-host/config.json (mode 0600: the control plane, the host's ID and credential, and its settings)
==> Start the service
  mkdir  $TMP/etc/systemd
  mkdir  $TMP/etc/systemd/system
  write  $TMP/etc/systemd/system/kantel-host.service (the kantel-host systemd unit, mode 0644)
  run    systemctl daemon-reload
  run    systemctl enable --now kantel-host
  run    systemctl restart kantel-host

Each file it gets is written as <name>.part and renamed when its digest matches; an image's digest is kept beside it in <name>.sha256-source, so running install again keeps what's already there.
Install adds no users or groups (kantel-host runs as root) and changes no sysctl settings.
Once it runs, the service keeps sandboxes, snapshots and templates under $TMP/var/lib/kantel-host, and memory snapshots in RAM at /dev/shm/kantel-host first.
For microVMs, kantel-host sets up its own network when it registers and each time the service starts: iptables chains KANTEL-INPUT and KANTEL-FORWARD, jumped to from INPUT, FORWARD and (on a host with Docker) DOCKER-USER, and ip6tables rules that drop its devices' traffic. The service adds a TAP device (kt0, kt1, …) in 10.231.0.0/16 for each microVM, with IPv6 off on it, and its egress proxy takes port 3129 on those devices only.

Dry run: nothing has been changed, and the token hasn't been used. Run the same command without --dry-run to install.
